surface: A notification toast: its live message when it appears, F6 into the notification region, its actions and close button, and Escape back to the grid.

steps.note: The application shows a toast while the user is in the grid (the page's own toast, shown on load, is still there too). It is an error toast, `role=alert`: a reader should say its title, `bottom end`, and its message without a focus move. The toast takes no focus, by design.
F6 moves the focus into the notification region, on a toast's first action. Both actions of the fixture's toasts are named `Action`.
Escape leaves the region, and the focus goes back to the cell the user was on, `Company 0`.
The grid has the keyboard again.
Enter closes this toast, and the focus moves to the other toast's first action.
